Subject: Question on payment flow — card vs monthly invoice and net terms

Hi Sofia / Ben,

We're finalizing procurement for the Hosted API pilot and need to confirm a few things on billing:

- Can Acme be billed on a monthly invoice (Net30) rather than card charges?
- If Net30 is possible, what vendor paperwork and lead time do you need (W-9, credit app, vendor form)?
- Is there an option for ACH payments instead of checks?
- Do you offer a discount for committed annual spend, and what are the thresholds?

Payments will prefer invoices to go to payments@acme-analytics.com with a PO number. I can loop them in once we have the necessary docs and a quote. We are also evaluating whether upfront credits would make sense for the pilot.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Jenna Park
Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front:

- Yes, we support monthly invoicing on Net30 with a standard credit check and completed W-9/vendor form.
- ACH is supported; we can send details for setting up ACH payments (bank remittance info) once billing is live.
- Typical onboarding time for invoice/billing setup is 7–10 business days after paperwork is returned and credit is approved.
- Volume discounts: we have benchmark tiers; for example, we can offer a pricing credit for committed annual minimums (I outline options in the attached rate card).

I'll attach our latest rate card and a template W-9 request for your finance team. Ben — any further notes on lead time or DocuSign process?

If helpful, we can produce a formal Net30 quote and a sample invoice for payments@acme-analytics.com. Would you like that in parallel or after the contract signature?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova

Thanks Jenna — quick operational notes from Sales Ops / Billing: 

1) Paperwork: we will need a completed W-9 (US org), a vendor contact, and a billing address. If Acme requires a vendor form, please attach it back to us and we will complete the vendor setup.

2) Lead time: once we have the W-9 + vendor form + PO (if required), we typically enable invoicing within 7 business days.

3) Discounts / commits: standard options we can quote —
   - 10% credit on hosted API list rates for a 12-month committed annual spend >= $120,000
   - 7% credit for a 12-month commit >= $60,000
   - For shorter pilots (3 months) we can offer a one-time trial credit; amounts are small (e.g., $1k–$5k) and depend on expected token usage.

4) DocuSign / contract: we can send a SOW/Order Form via DocuSign. If procurement needs a countersigned PDF before setting up invoices, we'll prioritize that.

I've looped in Lauren from Finance to confirm tax/invoice flow and whether we can send initial invoices to payments@acme-analytics.com while the PO is being processed.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks — I can share a PO template if it helps.

Best,
Jenna
